QF.id: Role of RTAs in Mutual Fund Transactions_20

question.text: Which type of equity fund must invest at least 75% of total assets in equity and equity-related instruments, with a minimum of 25% each in large cap, mid cap, and small cap stocks?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, a Multi Cap Fund must invest at least 75% of total assets in equity and equity-related instruments, with a minimum of 25% each in large cap, mid cap, and small cap stocks. This ensures genuine diversification across all three market-cap segments. The Trap: Flexi Cap Fund sounds similar but has no mandatory minimum allocation to any specific cap segment. The defining feature of Multi Cap is the 25%/25%/25% requirement across large, mid, and small cap together with the 75% overall equity floor. Note: The Multi Cap vs Flexi Cap distinction is tested across NISM Series V-A and II-B. Use the 75% / 25-25-25 wording for Multi Cap; reserve the "no mandated cap split" wording for Flexi Cap.
